title: Low-Latency LLM-Based Streaming Multi-Talker ASR with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2611.19136v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based architectures offer strong generalization and instruction-following capabilities for streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR), but multi-talker use introduces coupled transcription, attribution, and latency challenges. Our wearable setting requires real-time transcription of a conversation between a near-field device wearer and a far-field partner. Because partial hypotheses are rendered on persistent sides of a dialogue UI, speaker roles cannot be permuted and each speaker tag must precede its turn. These sparse tags are weakly optimized by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while committing to a leading tag can delay the text that follows. We therefore post-train a streaming LLM-based ASR model with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), combining a fixed-role Speaker-Attributed WER (SA-WER) grader with a turn-level onset-delay reward. translated_title: 基于可验证奖励的低延迟大语言模型流式多说话人语音识别
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的架构为流式自动语音识别（ASR）提供了强大的泛化能力和指令遵循能力，但在多说话人场景下会引入转录、说话人归属与延迟相互耦合的挑战。我们的可穿戴设备场景需要对近场设备佩戴者与远场对话伙伴之间的对话进行实时转录。由于部分转写假设会持续呈现在对话界面的固定一侧，说话人角色不能被置换，且每个说话人标签必须出现在其对应话语轮次之前。这些稀疏的说话人标签在监督微调（SFT）中只能得到弱化优化，而过早提交先导标签又会延迟后续文本的输出。因此，我们采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对基于流式LLM的ASR模型进行后训练，将固定角色的说话人归属词错误率（SA-WER）评分器与轮次级的起始延迟奖励相结合。在一个八方向多说话人测试集上，SA-WER强化学习将SA-WER从20（原文数值在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对流式LLM语音识别模型进行后训练，将固定角色说话人归属WER评分器与轮次级起始延迟奖励相结合，在可穿戴设备实时多说话人对话转录中同时解决转录准确性、说话人归属和低延迟三大难题。
en_tdlr: The paper post-trains a streaming LLM-based ASR model with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards, combining a fixed-role Speaker-Attributed WER grader with a turn-level onset-delay reward to jointly address transcription accuracy, speaker attribution, and low latency in real-time wearable multi-talker conversation transcription.
